title: Humans as slave workers in Eden

tellings.quote: out of the garden uh where by the way they were workers because you know the nakedness in antiquity was a sign of slave labor and [snorts] we were killers of the field in Eden for the gods except we didn't know it.

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels that humans in the Garden of Eden were slave workers for "the gods" without knowing it. He argues that in the ancient world nakedness was a sign of slave labor, so the naked Adam and Eve were field workers. He credits the King James Bible, published in 1611, which says God put the man in the garden "to dress it and to keep it" and later sent him out "to till the ground". Whether that work was a slave's labor for gods, the text neither says nor rules out.
